info.title: State labor agency wage claims: figures printed in state reports: data API
info.summary: Static, read-only JSON and CSV files. No key, no sign-up. CORS open.
info.description:
State labor agency wage claims: figures printed in state reports: Wage-claim counts that state labor agencies print in their own reports, one row per figure with the document's URL and a verbatim quote: the California Labor Commissioner's Office (wage claims filed in 2021, from its Labor Code section 96.1 report) and the Washington Department of Labor & Industries (wage complaints in state fiscal years 2024 and 2025, from its Workplace Rights Investigations reports). Each quote is re-checked against the document at each refresh. States whose pages block the fetcher or publish no count are not included.

Probative is a marketing firm, not a law firm; not legal advice. Every JSON response starts with a "meta" object holding the credit line, citation, DOI and license (CC BY 4.0).
